messages.author: Claire Harmange Magnani
messages.body:
Hi,
I am installing Amber22 and Ambertools23 on a Mac OS Ventura (Intel). When
I run "cmake install" the installation eventually ends with "fixing
miniconda script shebangs." There is no subsequent error message; however,
I can tell that there are some key things missing. In particular, the NAB,
which appears to never be made. It is not present in $AMBERHOME/bin/nab.
Are there other possible root causes for why the NAB does not get installed?
Thank you for any advice you can provide.
Claire Magnani
